question: Should `openclawProgressKind: "tool-progress"` and `isToolProgressPayload` become a permanent public Plugin SDK contract for third-party producers and channels?
rationale: The native-block defect has a mechanical repair, but review evidence cannot decide the long-term public ownership and compatibility commitment of the new generic SDK surface.

options.title: Adopt the generic contract
options.body: Keep the additive metadata and predicate as the shared producer-to-channel progress-intent seam after repairing native-block propagation.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep progress intent internal or owner-local and remove the new third-party Plugin SDK exports before landing.

recommendation.title: Adopt the generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep the additive metadata and predicate as the shared producer-to-channel progress-intent seam after repairing native-block propagation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the affected native-block delivery architecture and most closely spans the Slack and Plugin SDK decision surface.
